subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on August 15, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: ABC123 Departure: 10:00 AM Arrival: 2:00 PM We advise you to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Airlines Team
